title: Successor States Of Bahmani Kingdom Bidar
definition: The Barid Shahi dynasty of Bidar was one of the five Deccan Sultanates that emerged following the disintegration of the Bahmani Kingdom in the late 15th and early 16th centuries.
importanceInUpsc: UPSC frequently tests the chronology, geographical location, and inter-state dynamics of the Deccan Sultanates (Bijapur, Golconda, Ahmadnagar, Bidar, Berar) to assess candidate knowledge of regional medieval history.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Successor States Of Bahmani Kingdom Bidar.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Geopolitical landscape of the Deccan in the 15th century
